verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, asacchikataṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati asacchikatā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who haven’t realized mindfulness of the body haven’t realized freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, sacchikataṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati sacchikatā”ti.
verses.english: Those who have realized mindfulness of the body have realized freedom from death.”
The thousand discourses of the Ones are completed.
That is what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṁ abhinandunti.
verses.english: Satisfied, the mendicants approved what the Buddha said.
The Book of the Ones is finished.
